verdict.rationale: Docs show webhook events for refresh completions (balance, ownership, transaction) and a relink API for inactive accounts, which provide some signal that an account/connection has degraded, but there is no documented institution status page, no outage/degradation signal feed, and no error-code taxonomy that distinguishes a bank-side problem from an integration-side problem. Missing for 10: institution health/status dashboard, explicit outage signals, and documented error codes separating bank vs. merchant-side failures.
